trajectory_summary: The call built real energy — the customer volunteered home details, expressed genuine curiosity about net-metering, and disclosed a personal loss — but the rep never converted that energy into a locked appointment or a clean bill capture. It ends on a soft, unanchored promise to 'touch base tomorrow' rather than a booked time.
outcome_dispute: This should not be read as booked or tentative in the strong sense; no day/time was set, only a vague 'touch base tomorrow' — closer to a callback with a loosely stated timeframe.
